summary.text: Kenneth Abram is the Republican candidate for the Missouri House of Representatives, District 92, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democratic incumbent Michael Burton.

paragraphs.text: Kenneth Abram advanced from the August 4, 2026 Republican primary for District 92.
Ballotpedia lists him as the Republican candidate in District 93 in 2022, when incumbent Bridget Walsh Moore defeated him, and in District 92 in 2024, when incumbent Michael Burton defeated him.
